name: Homepage shows job search and company sections
description: A visitor opens the JobSearch homepage and sees the hero search, employer switch, company section, popular section, vacancies and footer.

planSteps.description: Verify the JobSearch brand is visible
Verify the hero search form is visible with city and employment type fields
Verify the buttons Ищу работу and Ищу сотрудника are visible
Verify the section Работа в компаниях is visible
Verify the section Новые вакансии is visible
Verify the footer contains support@jobsearch.ru and © 2026 JobSearch
